note: Loan parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Seven capabilities are graded: the four-bucket repayment allocation (loan-repayment-allocation seam), the single-period schedule-interest rounding of the discriminating SEED-L06 loan (loan-schedule-interest seam), the net disbursal amount (loan-disbursement seam), the derived total-outstanding of the SEED-L03 post-repayment summary (loan-summary-outstanding seam), the persisted loan-status ordinal read-back (loan-status seam), the derived per-row outstandingLoanBalance column of the transactions read-back (loan-transaction-balance seam), and the derived debit/credit totals AND per-(transaction, account) side of a loan-produced multi-pair journal-entry batch (loan-journal-entry-batch-balance seam). The SEED-L01 interest waiver arithmetic is captured but NOT in the graded domain: the loan slice has no interest-waiver arithmetic (interest is not a LoanCharge; LoanCharge.Waive covers fee/penalty charges only), so no vector may require it. The waiver's read-back footprint — a posting that does NOT move the outstanding balance — IS graded, under the transaction-balance capability.

capabilities.name: repayment-allocation
capabilities.description: The four-bucket greedy allocation of a repayment across penalty/fee/interest/principal of one instalment, as written back in the SEED-L03 repayment transaction (transaction 12).
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-3-transactions-after-raw.json under tenant gerege: transaction 12 (REPAYMENT, amount 8884.88) wrote back principalPortion 7884.88 and interestPortion 1000.00; the first instalment's due amounts are transcribed from loan-3-schedule-raw.json periods[1].

capabilities.name: transaction-balance
capabilities.description: The running outstandingLoanBalance column of the transactions read-back, DERIVED row by row from principal portions (I-3: balances derived, never written). A waiver moves the balance by zero; an accrual row carries NO balance at all (absent, never zero); a repayment moves the balance by its principal portion alone.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-1-transactions-after-raw.json under tenant gerege: the waive-interest transaction (1000.00) read back outstandingLoanBalance 100000.00, unchanged from disbursement; the accrual transaction (6618.53) read back outstandingLoanBalance null. Capture loan-3-transactions-after-raw.json: the repayment transaction 12 (8884.88, principalPortion 7884.88) read back outstandingLoanBalance 92115.12.

capabilities.name: journal-entry-batch-balance
capabilities.description: TWO properties of a loan-produced journal-entry batch read back from the journal-entries endpoint. First, the derived debit and credit totals, summed independently over EVERY leg: sum(debits) == sum(credits), exactly, in integer minor units. A batch holding MORE THAN ONE PAIR (a disbursement pair plus a fee pair) discriminates a port that sums only the first pair, drops a pair, or nets the two legs on one GL account; a single-pair batch cannot. Second, WHICH account takes WHICH side in WHICH transaction — the per-(transaction, account) side list, keyed on the observed account, not on the account's normal balance. A port that reverses both legs of a balanced pair keeps the two totals equal and still "balances" while crediting the account that was debited; only the side list sees it. The property is per-(transaction, account), not per-account globally: OHLGR-Fund-Source is CREDIT in L17 and DEBIT in L18.
capabilities.evidence: Capture gl-accounting-surface/out/journalentries-all-raw.json under tenant gerege: loan entityId 10 read back four entries — transaction L17 debit OHLGR-Loan-Portfolio 100000.00 / credit OHLGR-Fund-Source 100000.00, and transaction L18 credit OHLGR-Income-From-Fees 100.00 / debit OHLGR-Fund-Source 100.00 — so sum(debits) 100100.00 == sum(credits) 100100.00, and the four (transactionId, glAccountName, entryType.value) triples are the observed side list. The single-pair loan entityId 12 batch (L20, 100000.00 each way) balances under almost any defect and is not used to grade this property.

capabilities.name: schedule-interest-rounding
capabilities.description: The single-period interest of the discriminating loan SEED-L06 (principal 100050.50 at 12%/yr, 360-day year / 30-day month), whose period-1 raw interest 1000.505 ties HALF_UP (1000.51) against HALF_EVEN (1000.50).
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-L06-schedule-raw.json under tenant gerege: periods[1].interestOriginalDue is 1000.510000, the HALF_UP rounding of the MANIFEST's raw interest 1000.505; the oracle posted 1000.51.

capabilities.name: disbursement-net
capabilities.description: The net disbursal amount of the SEED-L06 disbursal: approved principal minus charges due at disbursement, as written back in the loan detail read.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-L06-detail-raw.json under tenant gerege: netDisbursalAmount 100050.50 with feeChargesAtDisbursementCharged 0.0 (no charges due at disbursement).

capabilities.name: summary-total-outstanding
capabilities.description: The loan summary's total outstanding, DERIVED from the four outstanding buckets (principal, interest, fee, penalty) of a loan detail read-back. Fineract persists total_outstanding_derived; the port's LoanSummary keeps the bucket decomposition and derives the total (derive-don't-store).
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-3-detail-after-raw.json under tenant gerege: the SEED-L03 post-repayment summary read back principalOutstanding 92115.12, interestOutstanding 5618.53, fee/penaltyChargesOutstanding 0, and totalOutstanding 97733.65 (the sum of the four buckets).

capabilities.name: loan-status-encoding
capabilities.description: The persisted loan-status ordinal (m_loan.loan_status_id) decoded into the enum's i18n code, and the ordinal the decoded enum round-trips back to on re-persist. Fineract's status table is NON-contiguous (APPROVED 200, ACTIVE 300, closed 6xx), so a port encoding the enum as an iota collapses states.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-L06-approve-raw.json under tenant gerege: the SEED-L06 approval returned changes.status id 200 code loanStatusType.approved; capture loan-1-detail-raw.json read back status id 300 code loanStatusType.active on SEED-L01.

capabilities.name: interest-waiver
capabilities.description: The SEED-L01 interest waiver. The loan slice has no interest-waiver arithmetic (interest is not a LoanCharge; LoanCharge.Waive covers fee/penalty charges only), so promotion does not port new arithmetic for it.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-1-transactions-after-raw.json: the SEED-L01 waive-interest transaction exists, but no loan-slice arithmetic reproduces its interest amount.

seams.name: loan-repayment-allocation
seams.description: The SEED-L03 repayment transaction read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the four-bucket greedy allocation of repayment 12.

seams.name: loan-schedule-interest
seams.description: The SEED-L06 schedule read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the period-1 single-period interest, the discriminating rounding surface.

seams.name: loan-disbursement
seams.description: The SEED-L06 loan detail read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the net disbursal amount.

seams.name: loan-summary-outstanding
seams.description: The SEED-L03 loan detail read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the post-repayment summary block (four outstanding buckets and the derived total outstanding).

seams.name: loan-status
seams.description: The loan-status read-backs on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the SEED-L06 approval command's changes.status block (approved, id 200) and the SEED-L01 loan detail read-back's status block (active, id 300).

seams.name: loan-transaction-balance
seams.description: The transactions read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the per-row outstandingLoanBalance column of SEED-L01 (disbursement 100000.00, accrual null, waive-interest 100000.00) and SEED-L03 (disbursement 100000.00, accrual null, repayment 92115.12).

seams.name: loan-journal-entry-batch-balance
seams.description: The journal-entries read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the debit and credit totals of the multi-pair batch generated for loan entityId 10 (disbursement pair L17 plus fee pair L18), whose four legs sum to 100100.00 on each side.
